factChecks.explanation: Multiple reliable sources confirm that Ben Black's April Fools' story was mistakenly presented as real news by Google's AI. According to BBC News and TechSpot, he expressed his shock at discovering that his fabricated article was used by Google's AI tool as actual information.
factChecks.reasoning: The primary sources, including BBC News, TechSpot, and others corroborate Mr. Black's claim about his prank story being misrepresented by Google's AI. These articles detail his experiences and the confusion that occurred when the false information was circulated as fact.

sources.title: 'Google AI presented my April Fools' story as real news'
sources.description: Despite altering the wording of his article that afternoon, when he searched for it on 1 April he said he was "shocked" and "worried" to find the false information being used by Google's AI tool and presented as real information.
